verdict.rationale: Secureframe offers recurring schedules only inside specific built-in compliance workflows: user access reviews with recurring schedules and reminders, vendor reviews recurring by risk level, and customizable notifications for regular tasks such as quarterly access reviews and annual pentests. Its daily monitoring runs automatically and is not user-scheduled. There is no evidence of a general-purpose scheduler for arbitrary jobs or workflows. Missing for 10: user-defined scheduling of arbitrary jobs/workflows, scheduling via API or MCP for AI-native automation, schedule management details (cron/frequency options, run history), independent corroboration.
